review_scope: Exhaustive archive, section and paragraph completeness checks; targeted five-language editorial comparison of argument, evidence boundaries, conclusions and idiom. Not independent line-by-line historical certification of all twenty manuscripts.
notes: EP13 preserves the distinction between the recorded penalty, contemporary controversy and later interpretation of the referee's motive. The rule-reform account and collective defensive incentives remain intact.

EP14 retains Baggio's need to score to keep Italy's chance alive, not a claim that scoring would have won the title. Escobar's murder conviction remains distinct from an unproven complete chain of orders and motives.

EP15 preserves Ronaldo's denial, the unadopted parliamentary report and the absence of proof for the Nike allegation. The source's categorical interpretation that none of the witnesses was lying is inherited authorial interpretation, not an independently verified finding in this language review.

EP16's approved correction distinguishes disputed decisions, likely errors and explicit errors. The two assertions that all three calls were wrong are corrected in Chinese, English and five editions, together with corresponding later recaps. Offside error and lack of established manipulation remain distinct.
EP16 is shorter in the Chinese source itself: 39 paragraphs across eight sections. All five supplied editions preserve those paragraphs; this is not a condensed translation.
All source HTML except the explicitly logged EP16 phrases remains byte-for-byte protected. This batch does not add or claim a separate Traditional Chinese edition.
